reuse.why: Reuses the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked check and its single call path for all providers, but copies the field-clearing update from unlinkAccount instead of extracting it into a shared local-unlink helper that both could call.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount block that defines an 'unlinked account' is duplicated verbatim from unlinkAccount, so the definition of unlinked now lives in two places.

placement.why: The takeover mutation is placed inside a function named and shaped as a precondition check (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked), mixing validation with a side effect.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the takeover branch and one test; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: The flag is threaded uniformly through every provider, but a maintainer must remember to keep the copied unlink fields in sync with unlinkAccount, and the check's name no longer describes what it does.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked re-implements unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount detachment rather than factoring out the local part of unlinkAccount (the comment explains avoiding the GoCardless side effect, but no shared piece is extracted).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied update block is an overt verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's update.
